buckets.name: Corporate Carbon Accounting & Disclosure Software
buckets.scope: Software for measuring, managing, and reporting an organization's own scope 1/2/3 emissions and climate disclosures (company-level; product/supplier-level lives in Supply Chain bucket)
variations: horizontal enterprise carbon accounting platforms
SMB/mid-market lightweight carbon accounting
ERP/CRM-embedded sustainability suites from software incumbents
AI-automated emissions data ingestion (utility bills, invoices, ledgers)
emission factor databases & carbon calculation APIs
industry-vertical carbon accounting (construction, real estate, healthcare, events)
CSRD/ESRS, ISSB, and SEC disclosure & ESG reporting compliance software
net-zero target setting, transition planning & decarbonization roadmap tools
carbon data assurance & audit-readiness tooling
internal carbon pricing & marginal abatement cost (MACC) tools

buckets.name: Emissions Monitoring & Climate Intelligence
buckets.scope: Measured/observed emissions data — satellites, sensors, and AI-derived inventories — as distinct from activity-based accounting software
variations: satellite methane & GHG detection and quantification
aerial, drone & flyover plume surveys
ground-based continuous emissions sensors at facilities (laser, IoT)
facility CEMS and industrial stack-monitoring software
AI-derived global asset-level emissions inventories (power plants, steel, cement)
real-time grid carbon intensity data & APIs for carbon-aware computing/loadshifting
land-use change, deforestation & wildfire emissions monitoring
commodity-flow and trade emissions intelligence
super-pollutant tracking beyond CO2/CH4 (N2O, SF6, HFCs)
atmospheric flux networks & inversion modeling analytics

buckets.name: Carbon Market Infrastructure & Services
buckets.scope: The plumbing and assurance of voluntary and compliance carbon markets (demand-side and market middle layer; supply-side developers in next bucket)
variations: carbon credit registries (legacy standards bodies & next-gen digital registries)
spot/futures exchanges, marketplaces & brokerage desks
API-based credit retail & embedded offsetting for consumer apps
buyer-side procurement & credit portfolio management platforms
CDR-specific procurement platforms & advance market commitments
credit ratings & risk-scoring agencies
carbon credit insurance & buffer-pool alternatives
tokenized carbon & blockchain registry infrastructure
compliance market software (ETS allowance management & trading, cap-and-trade tooling)
Article 6 / sovereign carbon infrastructure and market intelligence/price data providers

buckets.name: Carbon Credit Project Developers & Digital MRV
buckets.scope: Supply side of carbon markets: originating nature-based and avoidance credit projects plus the dMRV verifying them (engineered CDR supply censused in the CDR sector)
variations: avoided deforestation / REDD+ developers

improved forest management & agroforestry programs

blue carbon (mangrove, seagrass, wetland) developers
household device programs (clean cookstoves, water purification credits)

digital MRV & remote-sensing verification platforms for carbon projects
carbon project finance, streaming & origination platforms

C&I demand response & flexibility aggregators
utility-grade DERMS
EV managed charging & V2G aggregation software
home energy management systems & smart-panel software
behind-the-meter C&I energy optimization and efficiency-as-a-service software

interconnection queue & hosting capacity automation
